item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 11/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will be generally fine over the region. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow night, and will bring cool weather to the region. With the monsoon moderating gradually midweek next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. Another northeast monsoon will affect southern China next weekend. Besides, a tropical cyclone will form over the western North Pacific next week, and will move in the general direction towards the vicinity of the Philippines.
